name: Wings of Light
description: In a misty forest clearing at dawn, feathered wings of light grow from the shoulders and lift the subject.

wardrobe.man: a loose white linen shirt and light trousers
wardrobe.woman: a long flowing white linen dress

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. {references} The {subject} is the only person in the new still, with exactly {their} face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline, hairstyle, hair colour{facial_hair}, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. The clothing, the place and the light come only from this description. The {subject} stands barefoot in the middle of a misty forest clearing at dawn, facing the camera, wearing {wardrobe}. Tall pine trunks surround the clearing, beams of golden sunlight cut through the mist from behind on the right, dew glitters on the grass and ferns, and fine particles float in the light. Medium-wide shot at eye level, the {subject} centered, full body visible. Cinematic photography, warm backlight through mist, soft volumetric god rays, gentle green and gold tones. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, untouched forest throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} ALREADY stands still in the clearing and breathes in, eyes on a point just past the camera. Two great feathered wings made of soft white light grow out of {their} shoulder blades and unfold wide to both sides, every feather glowing and shedding drifting motes of light; the wings beat once, slowly, the mist swirling away from them, and the {subject} rises gently off the grass and hovers a metre above it, toes pointing down, the dress or clothes rippling, glowing feathers drifting down. The camera tilts up slowly with {them}. Sound: a soft rising airy shimmer, one slow heavy wing beat, birdsong in the forest. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, glowing light feathers and volumetric light, sharp detail, stable picture.
generic_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} in the frame stays in place and breathes in. Two great feathered wings made of soft white light grow out of {their} shoulder blades and unfold wide to both sides, every feather glowing; the wings beat once, slowly, and the {subject} rises gently off the ground and hovers, glowing feathers drifting down. The camera keeps the same framing and the same movement it already has. Sound: a soft rising airy shimmer, one slow heavy wing beat. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, glowing light feathers and volumetric light, sharp detail, stable picture.
